# Generated ancient-current response. The selector keeps this action inside its own situation panel.
antq_m10_armenian_war_embassy = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		# The engine evaluates situation-action potential once without an actor
		# while building the global action registry.  Use the same optional
		# actor scope contract as the vanilla situation actions so that registry
		# discovery is silent; the country restriction is enforced whenever an
		# actor is present and repeated in the target selector below.
		scope:actor ?= {
			OR = { tag = XAA tag = XAO tag = XAH }
			can_see_situation = situation:antq_m10_armenian_war
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = { gold >= 14 }
		scope:recipient = { situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	cooldown = { type = antq_m10_armenian_war_embassy years = 2 }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:antq_m10_armenian_war = { add_to_list = source }
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:antq_m10_armenian_war = this
			situation_is_active = yes
			scope:actor = { OR = { tag = XAA tag = XAO tag = XAH } }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -14
			add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		}
		scope:recipient = { change_variable = { name = antq_m10_armenian_war_resolution_progress add = 14 } }
	}
}

	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		# The engine evaluates situation-action potential once without an actor
		# while building the global action registry.  Use the same optional
		# actor scope contract as the vanilla situation actions so that registry
		# discovery is silent; the country restriction is enforced whenever an
		# actor is present and repeated in the target selector below.
		scope:actor ?= {
			tag = BTV
			can_see_situation = situation:antq_s2_frankish_formation
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = { gold >= 59 }
		scope:recipient = { situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	cooldown = { type = antq_s2_frankish_formation_census years = 2 }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation

			situation:antq_s2_frankish_formation = { add_to_list = source }
		}
